revenue.notes: Web estimates vary $44-100M – using midpoint for placeholder

engagement_background.objective: Reduce procurement costs across indirect categories while supporting rapid growth.
engagement_background.scope_summary: Phase 1 (Jan-Sep 2021) covered Medical Supplies, Office Supplies, Courier, Small Parcel, IT HW, Telecom, Employee Benefits.  Phase 2 (Oct 2021 – Jan 2022) added Janitorial, Temp Labor, Billing System, Laundry, Waste, Copiers, Uniforms.

procurement_environment.data_availability: Limited spend visibility; fragmented supplier contracts

summary.headline: $1.2 M savings (19%) on $6.3 M spend
summary.narrative: Over two sourcing phases Treya addressed $6.3 million of baseline spend and delivered $1.2 million in annual run-rate savings (19 %).  Savings were achieved via competitive RFPs, incumbent negotiations, and GPO contracts with minimal operational disruption.

evidence.quote: Total project savings of $1.2M or 19% on $6.3M in baseline spend over 2 Phases

proof_points.statement: Majority of business retained with incumbents, ensuring rapid realization

evidence.quote: Majority of business remained with incumbent vendors… limited changes to operations required
